title: KAITO — Fury Incarnate〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: An empty SEKAI, huh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (According to Miku, she's already discovered her true feelings.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Other people besides her seem to be able to come and go as they please.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And yet, this Mafuyu still hasn't been able to figure out who she really is...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Based on what Miku said, her mother is preventing this from actually happening...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I need to ask...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What is it that makes you so angry...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everything...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's discovered her true feelings, but still hasn't made any actual progress.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The way you lot have been babying her is also infuriating.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And who are these other people that have been coming here? This isn't their SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Do you mean Kanade and the others...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Apparently, they all wished to “disappear” at one point or another...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why they understand how Mafuyu feels.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And they produce their own songs...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, Kanade is composing music in order to save Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ena and Mizuki also show great concern for her...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And has their presence led to any actual change...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, Mafuyu's learned to smile a little more...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, she's slowly beginning to comprehend what she's feeling...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's changing bit by bit...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu's doing her best...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You seriously believe that...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is she actually fighting back against her mother?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well...um...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Isn't that the first step she should be taking?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What I'm hearing is that her mother is doing everything she can to destroy who she is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: D-Destroy who she is...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right. And yet, she's not standing up to her. Do you all have some other plan in store?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We, um...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't want to see Mafuyu suffer...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And that's your reason for coddling her?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She avoids confronting her true feelings, comes here when she feels pain and gets a pat on the head from you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All you're doing is treating the symptoms. What sort of future do you think is waiting for her?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's why nothing's actually happened...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This is why I'm here...
That's why she called for me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, KAI...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't follow me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (This SEKAI belongs to... What was her name? Mafuyu?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (If no one else is going to do it, I'll just have to make her face reality myself.)
